blocks.heading: Forum for Origami Learning, Design, and STEAM Engagement
blocks.tagline: The FOLDS non-profit was created to support groups around the world who are using the art of origami to further STEM education.

blocks.heading: Our Mission
blocks.body: # To advance the understanding of origami and folding as bridges across science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics. We support education, research, and community engagement that connect classrooms and communities in the U.S. and abroad through origami and STEAM.
